statements.quote: We began to generate revenue from this business segment in fiscal year 2026, recognizing $385.3 million in revenue during the fiscal year ended May 31, 2026, with $270.6 million related to services revenue and $114.7 million related to data center rental and other revenue.
statements.notes: 'This business segment' is the HPC Hosting Business (AI/HPC data-center hosting for hyperscalers); the segment is HPC broadly rather than strictly AI, and the segment name is not stated within the sentence itself. The legacy Data Center Hosting Business (blockchain) is excluded.
